svg.title: Requirement ledger
svg.desc: Brief requirement: Relevant competitor comparison, Planned proof: Separate frozen candidate/Playwright-Chromium campaign on the same external tasks, seeds and model; report interface differences and retain every outcome; Brief requirement: Docs/SVGs and prominent stats, Planned proof: XML/link/data checks and inspected desktop/mobile renders; no green/orange metric accents; Brief requirement: Commit in chunks, Planned proof: Lead-owned focused commits; preserve the initial uncommitted patch
